scope: Bounded primary-source mechanism and validation review; no candidate backtests performed by this review

records.title: Stylized facts of intraday precious metals
records.institution: Monash; Trinity College Dublin; Southampton; Sydney
records.methodology: Intraday periodicity, return-volatility relationships, three subsamples
records.mathematical_model: Log returns; volatility; spread; Granger causality
records.main_finding: Session periodicity and two-way return-volatility dependence.
records.limitations: Descriptive wholesale data; no executable retail strategy.
records.reproducibility: Methods accessible; underlying licensed observations unavailable here.
records.relevance: Use session-conditioned nulls and separate directional prediction from volatility.
records.testable_hypothesis: Lagged volatility predicts magnitude beyond session-only baseline.
records.reading_status: Full text accessible; methods/results inspected; not independently reproduced

records.title: Who sets the price of gold? London or New York
records.institution: UTS; Stockholm School of Economics Riga; Trinity College Dublin
records.source: Journal of Futures Markets 36(6), 564-586; university manuscript
records.main_finding: Futures lead on average, with changing intraday structure.
records.limitations: Subsecond retail arbitrage not established; historical platform break; licensed data.
records.reproducibility: Equations available; synchronized original feeds unavailable.
records.relevance: Spot tick volume is not COMEX signed order flow.
records.testable_hypothesis: Future authorized synchronous feeds may test causal lead after latency/cost.
records.reading_status: University full manuscript accessible; data/method/results sections inspected

records.title: Impact of macroeconomic news on metal futures
records.source: Journal of Banking & Finance; university manuscript
records.dataset: Gold/silver/copper intraday futures and US releases, 2002-2008
records.methodology: Event-window regressions on standardized announcement surprises
records.main_finding: Rapid announcement response; important 08:30 US releases; asymmetric effects.
records.limitations: Contemporaneous explanatory relation; consensus timing and spreads critical.
records.reproducibility: Methods accessible; original consensus and futures data not reproduced.
records.relevance: Release calendars alone cannot recreate surprise signals.
records.testable_hypothesis: Compare post-window volatility forecast and abstention to matched nonevent days.

records.title: A Simple Approximate Long-Memory Model of Realized Volatility
records.institution: University of Lugano; Swiss Finance Institute
records.dataset: Financial realized-volatility empirical/simulation examples; not XAUUSD validation
records.mathematical_model: RV_next = b0 + bd*RV_day + bw*mean_RV_week + bm*mean_RV_month + error
records.limitations: Volatility prediction does not imply positive directional expectancy.
records.reproducibility: Equation implementable; no gold replication performed here.
records.relevance: Risk and feasibility baseline with past-only features.
records.testable_hypothesis: Chronological HAR forecast beats rolling variance on QLIKE without directional claim.

records.title: Time Series Momentum: Original Paper Data
records.mathematical_model: Direction from own past excess return; diversified factor construction
records.limitations: Monthly diversified result does not certify intraday single-market edge.
records.reproducibility: Original factor dataset offered; paper not fully reread here.
records.relevance: Basic trend exposure is a baseline, not a rescue of failed local variants.
records.testable_hypothesis: Any new signal must improve over a predeclared trend control.
records.reading_status: Primary dataset page read; underlying paper not claimed fully read

records.title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting and Non-Normality
records.source: Author manuscript; Journal of Portfolio Management
records.mathematical_model: Normal-CDF statistic using sample length, skewness, kurtosis and expected maximum Sharpe across trials
records.main_finding: Searching and nonnormality inflate apparent performance.
records.limitations: Effective trial count/dispersion required; leakage is not repaired.
records.reproducibility: Equations available; historical project trial count incomplete.
records.relevance: Report trial-count sensitivity rather than fabricated precise correction.
records.testable_hypothesis: Selected candidate clears declared search-adjusted benchmark.

records.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
records.institution: UC Davis/LBNL; Newcastle; Guggenheim; Western Michigan
records.mathematical_model: PBO = frequency(logit(relative OOS rank of IS winner) < 0)
records.limitations: Needs complete aligned trial matrix; not forward-market probability or leakage test.
records.reproducibility: Procedure public; hidden discarded project trials not reconstructible.
records.testable_hypothesis: A complete new candidate family retains ranks across partitions.
records.reading_status: Full manuscript accessible; procedure and limitations inspected

records.title: Real-Time Periods
authors: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
records.institution: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
records.methodology: Retrieve information known at historical dates
records.mathematical_model: Observation usable only when real-time availability precedes decision
records.main_finding: Revisions and current information differ from historical information sets.
records.limitations: Daily vintages do not supply intraday consensus timestamps.
records.reproducibility: Documented API; actual feature vintage availability must be checked.
records.relevance: Prevents revised CPI/PPI/NFP from leaking into past decisions.
records.testable_hypothesis: Any macro forecast survives publication-lag and first-release reconstruction.

records.title: Gold Futures Contract Specifications
records.dataset: Contract metadata, not empirical performance data
records.main_finding: GC is exchange-traded gold exposure with defined specifications.
records.limitations: Futures specifications cannot determine CFD/Atlas contract settings.
records.reproducibility: Public metadata; historical contracts and roll rules still required.
records.relevance: Prevents confusing GC volume and broker tick volume.
records.testable_hypothesis: Cross-venue features require synchronized quotes and explicit basis/roll controls.
